title.zh: v2.0.15 GS-1 定点接入完成：按帧寻址的实时调度 + 离线对等 + parity 测试（默认关闭，等你决定是否开启）
title.en: v2.0.15 GS-1 integration complete: frame-addressed live scheduling, an offline-equivalent path and a parity test (off by default, awaiting your call on enabling it)

highlights.zh: **接线三块拼齐，代码路径完整**：① 上游 GS-1 v2.1.5 提供按帧寻址的 `noteAt`/`noteOffAt` 并报告常数延迟；② 本仓 `gs1Tracks.ts` 是**唯一**的帧算术实现（秒→帧、**减去延迟补偿**、顺序确定、8 复音上限）；③ **实时**：`Gs1VoicePool` 每轨一个 host，输出接该轨 insert 输入，命中路由即 `return`（否则与原生双重发声），未就绪时返回 false 让原生接手并在后台加载；④ **离线**：`WavExporter` 在 `startRendering()` 之前建好并 await host，渲染循环内保持同步、同样按帧寻址、同样命中即 return。
highlights.en: **All three pieces are in place.** (1) Upstream GS-1 v2.1.5 provides frame-addressed `noteAt`/`noteOffAt` and reports its constant latency. (2) This repo's `gs1Tracks.ts` is the **only** implementation of the frame arithmetic (seconds to frames, **latency subtraction**, deterministic ordering, the 8-voice ceiling). (3) **Live**: `Gs1VoicePool` keeps one host per track, feeds that track's insert input, and returns early when routing hits (otherwise GS-1 and the native engine…

highlights.zh: **parity 由测试钉死**（`gs1ExportParity.test.ts`）：开关关闭时导出连 host 都不找（与以前逐字节一致）；开启时**离线事件帧 === 共享 planner 的帧 === 实时 pool 拿同样输入产生的帧**——这才是 parity 的正面表述：帧算术两边只有一份实现，谁再自己算一遍就是播放与导出漂移的开始；GS-1 接管的轨道不再产生原生振荡器（没有双重发声）。另外补上 `fakeAudio` 离线 context 缺失的 `audioWorklet` 表面——否则 GS-1 导出路径会跳过自身，parity 测试会「在没有图的情况下通过」。
highlights.en: **Parity is pinned by tests** (`gs1ExportParity.test.ts`): with routing off the exporter does not even look for a host (bit-for-bit as before); with it on, **the offline event frames equal the shared planner's frames, which equal what the live pool produces from the same input** — the positive statement of parity, since the frame arithmetic has exactly one implementation and re-deriving it on either side is how playback and export drift apart. A GS-1 track also stops creatin…

highlights.zh: **仍默认关闭，这是本版唯一的有意留白**：开启会改变 159 曲风 `chords`/`lead` 的听感（换合成器、换 patch），而这些 patch 从未做过听感 A/B，本仓库也无法测量「更好听」；且开启按硬规则必须**重测响度 + 音色基线并重配 trim**。开启只需一行（`setGs1RoutingEnabled(true)`），但**不该由我单方面决定**。本版没有任何一轨的声音发生变化。
highlights.en: **Still off by default, and that is this release's one deliberate omission.** Enabling it changes how `chords`/`lead` sound in all 159 genres (different synthesis, different patches), those patches have never been judged by ear, and this repository cannot measure \"sounds better\"; enabling it also triggers the hard rule that loudness and timbre must be re-measured and the trims re-fit. It is a one-line change (`setGs1RoutingEnabled(true)`) but **not a decision I should make…
